title: Jeweled Charred Middle Eastern Peas Knafeh
description: A crispy and flavorful Middle Eastern dish featuring charred peas and knafeh, perfect for a unique dessert or snack. This recipe is onion and garlic friendly and uses a bamboo steamer for a fun twist.
instructions: Preheat the bamboo steamer by filling it with water and bringing it to a boil.
In a large bowl, mix together the peas, melted butter, rose water, and orange blossom water.
Lay the knafah dough in the steamer and top it with the pea mixture.
Sprinkle the chopped pistachios and sliced almonds over the peas.
Cover the steamer and cook for 10 minutes or until the dough is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the knafeh from the steamer and let it cool for a few minutes.
Drizzle the honey over the top of the knafeh, if using.
Serve the Jeweled Charred Middle Eastern Peas Knafeh warm and enjoy.
Garnish with additional pistachios and almonds, if desired.
